projected_fields.name: run_state
projected_fields.meaning: Durable Run lifecycle class: Running, Awaiting, or Ended.

projected_fields.name: ticket_kind
projected_fields.meaning: Durable wait-reason class; None when no resume ticket exists.

projected_fields.name: ticket_call
projected_fields.meaning: Tool call correlated with the durable resume ticket, or no_call.

projected_fields.name: call_state
projected_fields.meaning: Per-call durable phase, with payloads erased.

projected_fields.name: attempts
projected_fields.meaning: Latest durably observed execution attempt per call, carried forward after execution.

projected_fields.name: batch_state
projected_fields.meaning: Absence, Open, or Finalized state of the durable active batch.

projected_fields.name: version
projected_fields.meaning: Trace-local contiguous commit ordinal; it is not a store record version.

erased_fields.name: message_and_output_payloads
erased_fields.reason: The model proves commit ordering and lifecycle state, not content semantics.

erased_fields.name: tool_arguments_and_continuations
erased_fields.reason: Opaque executor payloads do not affect the modeled durable transition guards.

erased_fields.name: usage_and_stop_metadata
erased_fields.reason: Accounting payload values are outside ThreadCommitProjection's lifecycle projection.

erased_fields.name: state_commands_outside_active_batch_and_delegations
erased_fields.reason: ThreadCommitProjection projects only ActiveToolBatch and RunDelegations. Every other typed state command is covered by the separate ThreadState model, the production state kernels consumed by ThreadCommit validation/materialization, Kani proofs, and the real MemoryCommitCoordinator atomicity/replay trace.

erased_fields.name: delegation_identity_except_parent_call_and_status
erased_fields.reason: Child IDs, lineage, target, and budget are covered by delegation-specific models rather than this commit-shape model.

erased_fields.name: run_thread_snapshot_and_catalog_identity
erased_fields.reason: Each scenario fixes these identities; their selection and isolation are covered by separate contracts.

erased_fields.name: storage_record_metadata
erased_fields.reason: The projection observes successful commit order and does not claim refinement of database timestamps or record-version implementation.
